title: Strict completed-coefficient realization of a coherent finite system
statement: Fix the prime l, coefficient extension E, scheme X, finite-field datum D, and l unequal to D.p as in [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. Let M_n be arbitrary objects of the finite coefficient derived categories, with semilinear transitions tau_{m,n}: M_m → Res_{m,n} M_n satisfying the unit equation tau_{n,n};U_n=id and the composition equation tau_{r,n};A_{r,m,n}^{-1}=tau_{r,m};Res_{r,m}(tau_{m,n}). There exist an object Z of the derived category of strict completed-coefficient inverse sequences and isomorphisms e_n:ev_n Z ≅ C_n M_n, where C_n denotes completed scalar restriction, such that for every n≤m the actual canonical derived evaluation transition of Z followed by e_n equals e_m followed by C_m(tau_{m,n}) and the canonical completed restriction comparison G_{m,n}(M_n). No normalization condition on the transitions and no inverse-limit assertion are required.

proof.text: Use completed restriction coherence and the assumed unit and cocycle equations to make K_n=C_n M_n with transition C_m(tau_{m,n});G_{m,n} into an inverse diagram in the completed coefficient derived category. Its identity and composition laws follow by functoriality and naturality.

The category of completed-coefficient module sheaves is Grothendieck abelian in the recorded universe. Choose a K-injective complex I_n and an isomorphism Q I_n ≅ K_n for every n. Since localization on homotopy classes into a K-injective target is bijective, each conjugated successor morphism K_{n+1}→K_n has a chain-map representative I_{n+1}→I_n. Choose these representatives and use finite composites to form the strict sequence T. Functor.ofOpSequence and NatTrans.ofOpSequence show that the isomorphisms Q I_n ≅ K_n extend to an isomorphism T⋙Q ≅ K, including every longer arrow.

Transpose the sequence of complexes T to a complex C of sequences, with the same differentials degreewise, and set Z=Q C. Compose the canonical exact-derived evaluation factorization at C with the component of T⋙Q ≅ K to define e_n. The localization formula for normalizedDVRTowerTransition says precisely that these factorization maps identify its transition with Q(T.map). Naturality of the sequence isomorphism proves the required square for every n≤m, including the identity case.

theorem normalizedDVR_strict_realization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{t}) (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{d}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (M : ∀ n : ℕ, normalizedDVRDerived l E X n)
    (tau : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m), M m ⟶ (normalizedDVRRes l E X h).obj (M n))
    (hu : ∀ n : ℕ, tau (Nat.le_refl n) ≫
      (normalizedDVRResUnit l E X n).hom.app (M n) = 𝟙 (M n))
    (hc : ∀ {r m n : ℕ} (hrm : m ≤ r) (hmn : n ≤ m),
      tau (le_trans hmn hrm) ≫ (normalizedDVRResComp l E X hrm hmn).inv.app (M n) =
        tau hrm ≫ (normalizedDVRRes l E X hrm).map (tau hmn)) :
    ∃ (Z : normalizedDVRDerivedTowers l E X D hl)
      (e : ∀ n : ℕ, (normalizedDVRTowerEvaluation l E X D hl n).obj Z ≅
        (normalizedDVRResCompleted l E X D hl n).obj (M n)),
      ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
        (normalizedDVRTowerTransition l E X D hl h).app Z ≫ (e n).hom =
          (e m).hom ≫ (normalizedDVRResCompleted l E X D hl m).map (tau h) ≫
            (normalizedDVRResCompletedComp l E X D hl h).hom.app (M n)
